forum.title: Nucleo-h563zi board spi2 not working
forum.category: STM32 MCUs Boards and hardware tools
forum.best_answer_content: Do functions return HAL\_OK? If so, probably the pin you are monitoring is not connected to the clock where you’re measuring. Check the board schematic.
forum.author: Hueiyi

scraped_replies.html: Do functions return HAL_OK? If so, probably the pin you are monitoring is not connected to the clock where you’re measuring. Check the board schematic.
scraped_replies.author: TDK

scraped_replies.html:
It does return HAL_OK.

I am using PA12 as the SPI2 clock pin, and I am confident that I connected to the correct pin since the board silkscreen clearly labels it as PA12.

Below are the pins I am using:
PC2   ------> SPI2_MISO
PC3   ------> SPI2_MOSI
PA12 ------> SPI2_SCK
PB6  ------>  SS
scraped_replies.author: Hueiyi

scraped_replies.html:
PA12 is not connected to the headers by default. You need to close some solder bridges. It is connected to USB. See the user manual or the schematic.

If it returns HAL_OK, the clock is working.
scraped_replies.author: TDK
